191	  ```

193	
194	### Step 3: 라우트 구현 — `src/routes/articles.crud.ts` 전체 코드
195	- [ ] 아래 코드를 그대로 작성한다.
196	
197	```ts
198	import type { FastifyInstance, FastifyReply, FastifyRequest } from 'fastify'
199	import { makeSlug } from '../lib/slug.js'
200	import { articleView } from '../lib/views.js'
201	
202	// articleView가 요구하는 관계를 항상 함께 로드한다.
203	const articleInclude = { author: true, tags: true } as const
204	
205	// following / favorited / favoritesCount 를 요청자(userId) 기준으로 계산하는 공통 헬퍼.
206	async function computeFlags(
207	  app: FastifyInstance,
208	  articleId: number,
209	  authorId: number,
210	  userId?: number,
211	): Promise<{ favorited: boolean; favoritesCount: number; following: boolean }> {
212	  const favoritesCount = await app.prisma.favorite.count({ where: { articleId } })
213	  let favorited = false
214	  let following = false
215	  if (userId) {
216	    const fav = await app.prisma.favorite.findUnique({
217	      where: { userId_articleId: { userId, articleId } },
218	    })
219	    favorited = fav !== null
220	    const fol = await app.prisma.follow.findUnique({
221	      where: { followerId_followingId: { followerId: userId, followingId: authorId } },
222	    })
223	    following = fol !== null
224	  }
225	  return { favorited, favoritesCount, following }
226	}
227	
228	const notFound = (reply: FastifyReply) =>
229	  reply.code(404).send({ errors: { body: ['not found'] } })
230	const forbidden = (reply: FastifyReply) =>
231	  reply.code(403).send({ errors: { body: ['forbidden'] } })
232	
233	type ArticlePayload = {
234	  article?: {
235	    title?: unknown
236	    description?: unknown
237	    body?: unknown
238	    tagList?: unknown
239	  }
240	}
241	
242	export default async function (app: FastifyInstance) {
243	  // 1) 생성 — POST /api/articles (auth required)
244	  app.post('/articles', { preHandler: app.authenticate }, async (req: FastifyRequest, reply: FastifyReply) => {
245	    const input = (req.body as ArticlePayload | undefined)?.article ?? {}
246	
247	    // 필수 필드 검증 → 422
248	    const errors: Record<string, string[]> = {}
249	    for (const field of ['title', 'description', 'body'] as const) {
250	      const v = input[field]
251	      if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.trim() === '') {
252	        ;(errors[field] ??= []).push("can't be blank")
253	      }
254	    }
255	    if (Object.keys(errors).length > 0) return reply.code(422).send({ errors })
256	
257	    const title = input.title as string
258	    const description = input.description as string
259	    const body = input.body as string
260	    const tagList: string[] = Array.isArray(input.tagList)
261	      ? (input.tagList as unknown[]).filter((t): t is string => typeof t === 'string')
262	      : []
263	
264	    // 각 태그를 upsert 하여 존재를 보장한 뒤 name 으로 connect 한다.
265	    for (const name of tagList) {
266	      await app.prisma.tag.upsert({ where: { name }, create: { name }, update: {} })
267	    }
268	
269	    const article = await app.prisma.article.create({
270	      data: {
271	        slug: makeSlug(title),
272	        title,
273	        description,
274	        body,
275	        author: { connect: { id: req.user!.id } },
276	        tags: { connect: tagList.map((name) => ({ name })) },
277	      },
278	      include: articleInclude,
279	    })
280	
281	    // 본인 글이므로 following 은 무의미하나 false. 새 글이므로 favorited/count 는 0.
282	    return reply
283	      .code(201)
284	      .send(articleView(article, { favorited: false, favoritesCount: 0, following: false }))
285	  })
286	
287	  // 2) 단건 조회 — GET /api/articles/:slug (auth optional)
288	  app.get('/articles/:slug', { preHandler: app.authOptional }, async (req: FastifyRequest, reply: FastifyReply) => {
289	    const { slug } = req.params as { slug: string }
290	    const article = await app.prisma.article.findUnique({ where: { slug }, include: articleInclude })
291	    if (!article) return notFound(reply)
292	
293	    const flags = await computeFlags(app, article.id, article.authorId, req.user?.id)
294	    return reply.send(articleView(article, flags)) // body 포함(includeBody 생략)
295	  })
296	
297	  // 3) 수정 — PUT /api/articles/:slug (auth required, author만)
298	  app.put('/articles/:slug', { preHandler: app.authenticate }, async (req: FastifyRequest, reply: FastifyReply) => {
299	    const { slug } = req.params as { slug: string }
300	    const existing = await app.prisma.article.findUnique({ where: { slug }, include: articleInclude })
301	    if (!existing) return notFound(reply)
302	    if (existing.authorId !== req.user!.id) return forbidden(reply)
303	
304	    const input = (req.body as ArticlePayload | undefined)?.article ?? {}
305	    const data: { title?: string; slug?: string; description?: string; body?: string } = {}
306	    if (typeof input.title === 'string' && input.title.trim() !== '') {
307	      data.title = input.title
308	      data.slug = makeSlug(input.title) // title 변경 시 slug 재생성
309	    }
310	    if (typeof input.description === 'string') data.description = input.description
311	    if (typeof input.body === 'string') data.body = input.body
312	
313	    const updated = await app.prisma.article.update({
314	      where: { id: existing.id },
315	      data,
316	      include: articleInclude,
317	    })
318	
319	    const flags = await computeFlags(app, updated.id, updated.authorId, req.user!.id)
320	    return reply.send(articleView(updated, flags))
321	  })
322	
323	  // 4) 삭제 — DELETE /api/articles/:slug (auth required, author만)
324	  app.delete('/articles/:slug', { preHandler: app.authenticate }, async (req: FastifyRequest, reply: FastifyReply) => {
325	    const { slug } = req.params as { slug: string }
326	    const existing = await app.prisma.article.findUnique({ where: { slug } })
327	    if (!existing) return notFound(reply)
328	    if (existing.authorId !== req.user!.id) return forbidden(reply)
329	
330	    await app.prisma.article.delete({ where: { id: existing.id } })
331	    return reply.code(200).send({})
332	  })
333	}
334	```
335	
336	> **설계 메모**
337	> - `computeFlags`가 `following`/`favorited`/`favoritesCount`를 한 곳에서 계산하도록 하여 조회·수정 경로에서 재사용한다.
338	> - 태그는 계약대로 `tag.upsert`로 존재를 보장한 뒤 유일 필드 `name`으로 `connect`한다.
339	> - 수정 시 `where: { id }`를 사용해 slug 변경으로 대상이 흔들리지 않게 한다.
340	> - 삭제 응답은 `200 {}`를 사용한다(계약상 `204`도 허용).
341	
342	### Step 4: 통과 확인
343	- [ ] 실행:
344	  ```bash
345	  npm test -- articles-crud
346	  ```
347	- [ ] 기대: 모든 테스트 통과(GREEN). 401/422/404/403 및 create→get→update(slug 변화)→delete 흐름 확인.
348	
349	### Step 5: 커밋
350	- [ ] ```bash
351	  git add -A && git commit -m "feat: add article CRUD routes (create/get/update/delete)"
352	  ```

354	## 완료 기준
355	- `POST /api/articles`
356	  - 미인증 → 401.
357	  - title/description/body 중 하나라도 빈값/누락 → 422 `{ errors: { <field>: [...] } }`.
358	  - 성공 → 201, `articleView`(body 포함, `favorited:false`, `favoritesCount:0`, `following:false`), `author`는 요청자.
359	  - `tagList`의 각 태그가 `tag.upsert`로 보장되고 article에 connect 된다.
360	- `GET /api/articles/:slug`
361	  - 없는 slug → 404.
362	  - 익명/인증 모두 200, body 포함. 인증 시 `favorited`/`following`이 요청자 기준으로 계산되고 `favoritesCount`가 정확하다.
363	- `PUT /api/articles/:slug`
364	  - 없는 slug → 404, author 아님 → 403.
365	  - 전달된 필드만 갱신. title 변경 시 slug가 `makeSlug`로 재생성되어 바뀐다. 갱신된 `articleView` 반환.
366	- `DELETE /api/articles/:slug`
367	  - 없는 slug → 404, author 아님 → 403. 성공 → 200 `{}`(또는 204). 이후 조회는 404.
368	- **테스트 방법:** `npm test -- articles-crud` 가 모두 통과한다. 테스트는 `app.prisma.user.create`로 저자/타인 두 계정을 만들고 `app.jwt.sign`으로 토큰을 발급해 create→get→update(slug 변화 확인)→타인 update/delete 403→author delete→삭제 후 404 를 검증한다. 유일값은 `Date.now()`로 확보한다.

import Fastify, { type FastifyInstance } from 'fastify'
import autoload from '@fastify/autoload'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path'
import './types.js'

import prismaPlugin from './plugins/prisma.js'
import jwtPlugin from './plugins/jwt.js'

  await app.register(prismaPlugin)

import jwt from '../src/plugins/jwt.js'

let app: FastifyInstance

    data: { username: `dother-${uniq}`, email: `dother-${uniq}@ex.com`, password: 'x' },
  })
  otherToken = app.jwt.sign({ id: other.id, username: other.username })
})
afterAll(async () => { await app.close() })

const auth = (t: string) => ({ authorization: `Token ${t}` })

test('lifecycle', async () => {
  const noauth = await app.inject({ method: 'POST', url: '/api/articles', payload: { article: { title: 'T', description: 'D', body: 'B' } } })
  expect(noauth.statusCode).toBe(401)

  const inv = await app.inject({ method: 'POST', url: '/api/articles', headers: auth(token), payload: { article: { title: '', description: 'D', body: 'B' } } })
  expect(inv.statusCode).toBe(422)
  expect(inv.json().errors.title).toBeDefined()

  const created = await app.inject({ method: 'POST', url: '/api/articles', headers: auth(token), payload: { article: { title: `Hello World ${uniq}`, description: 'D', body: 'B', tagList: ['a', 'b'] } } })

  const c = created.json().article

  expect(c.tagList).toEqual(['a', 'b'])

  expect(c.favoritesCount).toBe(0)
  expect(c.author.username).toBe(`dauthor-${uniq}`)
  const slug1 = c.slug

  expect(got.json().article.body).toBe('B')
  expect(got.json().article.author.following).toBe(false)

  expect((await app.inject({ method: 'DELETE', url: `/api/articles/${slug2}`, headers: auth(otherToken) })).statusCode).toBe(403)
  expect([200, 204]).toContain((await app.inject({ method: 'DELETE', url: `/api/articles/${slug2}`, headers: auth(token) })).statusCode)
  expect((await app.inject({ method: 'GET', url: `/api/articles/${slug2}` })).statusCode).toBe(404)
})
